moments.title: Bank Holiday Weather Warning
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday weekend in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is set for heavy rain and thunderstorms, following a summer of heatwaves.

angles.name: Rainy Forecast
angles.copy: Get ready for a soggy Bank Holiday weekend! The Met Office is warning of heavy rain and thunderstorms across England, Wales & Northern Ireland. Time to dig out the wellies! #BankHolidayWeather

angles.name: Indoor Plans
angles.copy: Looks like the Bank Holiday weekend is best spent indoors! Heavy rain and thunder expected. What are your last-minute indoor plans? 🌧️☔

moments.title: Creamfields Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's biggest electronic dance music festivals, runs from August 27-30 in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring headliners like Calvin Harris, Underworld, and Swedish House Mafia.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Daresbury is about to get loud with Calvin Harris, Underworld, Swedish House Mafia & more from Thursday. Who's ready to rave? #Creamfields2026

angles.name: Dance Anthem Prep
angles.copy: Getting in the mood for Creamfields 2026! What tracks are you hoping to hear from Calvin Harris, Disclosure and Tiësto this weekend? Drop your anthems! #CreamfieldsAnthems

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Weekend
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals take place from August 28-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is just days away! Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine are set to headline. Who are you most excited to see? #RandL26

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: The biggest weekend in UK music is almost here! Reading & Leeds brings an incredible lineup including Fontaines D.C. and Raye. Let's hear your festival predictions! #ReadingLeeds

moments.title: All Points East Final Weekend

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Last chance to catch All Points East! Tyler, The Creator, Twenty One Pilots & Deftones wrap up the festival this weekend in Victoria Park. Who's heading down? #APE26

angles.name: Community Days Wrap

moments.title: Roseshire Festival Debut
moments.blurb: The brand-new Roseshire Festival debuts on August 29-30 in Northamptonshire, featuring indie and alternative sounds on Saturday (The Charlatans, Embrace) and pop/90s nostalgia on Sunday.

angles.name: New Festival Alert
angles.copy: Northamptonshire gets a brand new festival this weekend! Roseshire Festival brings The Charlatans, Embrace & more for a mix of indie, alternative & 90s pop. Who's checking it out? #RoseshireFestival

angles.name: 90s Nostalgia

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the Official UK Singles Chart #1 spot for an incredible 22nd consecutive week (chart dated Aug 21-27, 2026).

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: Still number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make it 22 weeks at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. A true modern classic! #UKChart

angles.name: Power Duo
angles.copy: 22 weeks at #1 for Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' is unstoppable. What other tracks are you loving on the latest Official Singles Chart? #SamFender #OliviaDean
